direction: Two overlap-weighted peer surprises divided by 5 cents, clipped to [-3,3]
tail: One frozen risk severity feature: (HIGH count + 0.5 MEDIUM count)/4 across existing four risk diagnostics
fit: Separate logistic models; Laplace-smoothed earlier prevalence fixes intercept; ridge penalty 4 on slopes; minimum 8 same-era published earlier outcomes, both classes required
cutoff: Quarter end; own and future outcomes excluded; historical risk actual inputs restricted to published earlier quarters
scoring: Matched-row Brier and log loss versus rolling Laplace base rate, coarse calibration bins; modern large and ordinary groups separately
joint: Three-state probabilities use P(tail)*P(direction); independence approximation, not independently calibrated tail direction
selection: No hyperparameter search or tail-only fitting; no production adjustment; history already used for hypothesis development
